title: Carry the full thermal source normalizer in a finite capacity bound
statement: At the stated core/source interfaces, rho_bar=1/100000, a=49999/50000 and Gamma_eff=8*theta*R/a+8*theta give C_kappa >= Z_A/[kappa^-1+2*n*exp(Gamma_eff)]. The full Z_A replaces the bare allminus weight without an extensive normalizer loss or an unspecified large-R threshold. Require r+2<=R/3, r<L/4 and the original source edges, including A intersect B. The source proof is internally derived, not independently verified.

requires: Periodic L by L torus; n=L^2, theta>=4, phi=theta/R; actual per-site heatbath rates and fixed zero-coupling contour diagonals. A=C_r is the acquired thermal core and B={M>=0}. Require r>=1, r+2<=R/3, r<L/4 and the original source-edge convention, including A intersect B, with actual kappa>0. The sparse corollary additionally requires acquired Z_M5/Z_A<=1/(1-u_r), u_r<1, K=floor(5R^2), M<K+1 and embedded nonwinding filled domains.

assumptions: The negligible quantity is weighted current through the specified sparse entrance configurations, not the probability of every transition path containing one. Dense, winding and other entrances, physical growth/residence composition and the full transition mean remain open. The core-size and source convention are indispensable; finite examples violating them are rejected. Normalized capacity/thermal transport and Thomson methods pre-exist, and the coarse finite exponent does not improve the cited sharp asymptotic exponent. New proofs are internally derived and not independently verified. Existing N1722 scientific acceptances retain their own versions and full scope; no older result is downgraded or replaced.
costs: Original user-supplied 17,902-byte ZIP e4460aee is preserved with every unchanged member and checksum manifest. No included script is executed by Capital. The source reports its own finite exact and floating calculations; the 4x4 diagnostic does not verify the governing large-volume/core hypotheses, and scalar exact arithmetic does not independently prove the contour/flow theorem. Exponential certificate values are not exponential-time physical simulations. The actual clock kappa is retained; kappa=1 is illustrative. All source/access/transfer holds persist; no new primary-source recovery or novelty audit.
contract.units: Dimensionless Ising fields and Gibbs weights, actual per-site heatbath time and positive source-clock rate at the supplied finite-core hypotheses.
obstruction: Independently assess the new proof at its stated source/geometric interfaces when scientifically required, and construct coverage of dense and other significant channels plus physical growth/occupation and full-mean time. Publication imposes no new independent-review gate, physical experiment or new scientific verification. The full polynomial predictor remains unachieved; earlier all-positive-clock Q<=T<=(1+kappa*D0)*Q+D0 remains current.

review.scope: User-supplied internally derived proof at its stated interfaces; not independently verified. Included tests and prior-art checks retain their limited scope and are not executed by Capital.
